lines.en: Hello, Doctor. Are my test results here?
Yes. Your heart is strong and healthy.
That's good news. I was worried last night.
Don't worry. Your bones are good too.
How is my stomach? It felt heavy yesterday.
Your stomach is fine. Eat slowly and rest.
What about my skin? It is dry.
Drink more water. Your skin will feel soft.
lines.ko: 물을 더 마시세요. 피부가 부드러워질 거예요.

lines.en: Thank you, Doctor. I will walk every morning.
Good. Your heart and brain will love that.
lines.ko: 좋아요. 심장과 뇌가 아주 좋아할 거예요.

lines.en: My back hurts a little this morning.
No! Did you carry the heavy box yesterday?
Yes, I did. My shoulder hurts too.
Sit down. Let me touch your neck and shoulder.
lines.ko: 앉아요. 목이랑 어깨 좀 만져 볼게요.

lines.en: Yes, that feels nice. My heart is calm now.
Is your back better now?
A little. My bones are old, I think.
Your bones are fine. We will stretch together tonight.
lines.ko: 뼈는 괜찮아요. 오늘 밤 같이 스트레칭해요.

lines.en: Good idea. Will you help me every day?
Sure. Rest your back and shoulder now.
lines.ko: 물론이죠. 이제 등과 어깨를 쉬게 해요.
